arms.G: gate_policy='uhat', gate_threshold=0.0 FROZEN, gate_uhat_source='shadow' (the EXP-FP-0007 non-degenerate instrument, reused VERBATIM; UsefulnessPredictor class NOT modified).
arms.N: gate_policy='uhat', gate_threshold=+inf, gate_uhat_source='shadow' (never-apply: store intact, shadow predictor trains on counterfactual unconditional benefit; live predictor trains on realized benefit=0 - the EXP-FP-0006 degenerate fixed point, deployed deliberately as the no-correction arm). Distinct from M1's store-disabled lesion; everything held constant except correction application.

background: EXP-FP-0006: live-uhat sign gate collapsed (never-apply, 0.000 rate, 4 seeds) - policy REJECTED; clean ranking signal found: corr(uhat, benefit) = +0.40...+0.48 (in-sample, unconditional).
EXP-FP-0007: shadow-uhat gate non-degenerate (rate 0.791-0.800) and H SUPPORTED on pomaze 4 seeds (dGU seed-mean +0.3023, dGR +0.2532). Gate PROMOTED to INTEGRATED; CAUSAL withheld.
EXP-FP-0007R: replication 5 seeds x 3 envs NEGATIVE - no promotion. Combined 9-seed pomaze seed-mean dGU ~ +0.09, dGR ~ +0.13. Ranking signal replicates (13 seeds); decision value does not replicate.
EXP-FP-0009: decision value requires benefit base rate high AND benefit predictable in magnitude from retrieval features.
M1 (EXP-AB-M1 + repro5): disabling the episodic STORE selectively degrades pomaze (+2.200 / +2.158 seed-mean delta, 5/5 replicate) vs delayed_reward (+0.046 / +0.050).

EXP-FP-0006 secondary: skipping vs applying the CORRECTION is return-neutral on pomaze (per-seed dGU -0.33...+0.23) - in tension with M1; the store's causal leverage may not ride the per-tick correction.
This experiment tests the selective-deficit framing directly: (a) unconditional correction, (b) shadow-uhat-gated correction, (c) no correction (gate blocks 100%).
baseline: arm U = ungated (correction applied whenever available; current ArchB default).
closed_loop_caveat: The gated trajectory diverges from the ungated trajectory once gating blocks; the shadow predictor's training data is uncontaminated by gating (counterfactual unconditional benefit) but lives on the gated trajectory. Pairing by episode index shares env initial conditions, not trajectories.
executor: prototypes/architecture-b/exp_retrieval_gate_selective.py (written AFTER this seal; driver-only, additive: imports run_arm/uhat_benefit_corr/corr from exp_retrieval_gate_shadow; retrieval_gate.py, predictions.py, agent.py untouched).

frozen_gates.G0: instrument-validity: G-arm application rate strictly in (0,1) on >=3/4 seeds; else VOID as instrument failure (EXP-FP-0006 lesson).
frozen_gates.G1: fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new/modified code, pre-run.
frozen_gates.G2: determinism spot-check: first-seed G arm recomputed, unrounded compare at 1e-12, else VOID.

honest_prior: EXP-FP-0007/0007R combined 9-seed pomaze seed-mean dGU ~ +0.09 -> dUG ~ -0.09 (gated slightly ABOVE unconditional); EXP-FP-0006 secondary suggests dUN small. The preregistered SELECTIVE pattern requires the correction to carry >=0.25 return leverage, which prior data does not promise. The value is in testing the framing and bounding dGN, not in assuming the deficit.
hypothesis: The shadow-uhat gate is a faithful selective filter: gated retrieval captures the useful retrievals and skips the useless ones, so (b) performs BETWEEN (a) unconditional and (c) no-correction, with the deficit concentrated on trials (episodes) where retrieval mattered - NOT a uniform collapse.
null: CEILING: the correction carries no return leverage in this protocol (|mean(U)-mean(N)| <= 0.25 seed-mean) - the deficit question is vacuous (consistent with EXP-FP-0006 secondary).
UNIFORM: gated ~= no-correction while clearly below unconditional (seed-mean mean(G)-mean(N) <= 0.25 while mean(U)-mean(G) > 0.25) - the gate is just a broken filter.

NO-DEFICIT: gated >= unconditional (seed-mean mean(U)-mean(G) <= 0, i.e. dGU <= 0) - consistent with the EXP-FP-0007/0007R combined direction; no selective deficit because gating does not sacrifice retrieval value.

preregistered_metric.episode_returns: R_e^arm per seed s, arm in {U, G, N}, e=1..15; paired by (seed, episode index); identical primary seeds across arms.
preregistered_metric.leverage: L_e,s = mean realized benefit over correction-available ticks of episode e from the U-arm PredictionLog (target='retrieval_usefulness', field 'actual'); trial-level deficit De,s = R_e,s^U - R_e,s^G; corr_s = pearson(De, L_e) over 15 episodes.
preregistered_metric.means: mean_s^arm = mean over episodes. dUG_s = mean_s^U - mean_s^G; dGN_s = mean_s^G - mean_s^N; dUN_s = mean_s^U - mean_s^N.

verdict_rule.SELECTIVE: seed-mean dGN > 0.25 AND seed-mean dUG / seed-mean dUN < 0.5 (guard: |seed-mean dUN| <= 0.25 -> CEILING instead) AND >=3/4 seeds agree sign(dGN) > 0 AND >=3/4 seeds corr_s > 0.
verdict_rule.priority: evaluate CEILING first (guards), then UNIFORM, then SELECTIVE, then NO_DEFICIT. If none fires exactly, report the continuous values with the closest branch.

secondary_diagnostics: G apply rate per seed; N-arm gate stats (n_applied=0 expected).
corr(uhat, benefit) from U-arm PredictionLogs (ranking-signal replication; currently 13 seeds).
shadow corr from G arm; mean uhat applied vs blocked.
